'''Taelo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who along with [[Nonia Daal]] was instructed by a [[Unidentified teacher|teacher]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At one point, they fought killers on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and after their teacher's death, the two took on the assignment of protecting the village of [[Torosh]] from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and met the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Om'rahk]].<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Taelo appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Keeping the Peace]]''.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
